item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod kyi rgyud las 'jigs byed gshin rje nag po'i gsang sgrub gcod byed dug gdong dmar nag
item.coloph: gyer spungs chen po bla chen dran pa rje/ mdzad 'phrin srol bzang 'khrul med 'od ldan mas/ shing mo yos la snyan du brgyud pa bzhin/ lhag chad med par pho nya rta yi lor/ g.yung gling skyes mchog g.yung dbang kyis bskul ngor/ gsang gnas dbus phug dpal gyi yongs rdzong du/ mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pas dge/ dbal phur rgyud srung bkra shis zhal dro'o//
